lines.text: Many learners say: My ancient boss was very kind.
Better: My former boss was very kind.
Ancient means very old. Not now is former.
Former! He is my former boss.

data.wrong: My ancient boss was very kind.
data.right: My former boss was very kind.
data.why: Ancient means very old. Not now is former.

quiz.stem: He is not my boss now. He is my ___ boss.

native.tip: En anglais, “ancient” veut dire « très ancien », comme les pyramides. Pour « ancien patron », dites “former”.
